articles.title: Wedbush: Nvidia has 30-40% upside ahead
articles.summary: 24/7 Wall St.: Wedbush: Nvidia has 30-40% upside ahead. Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) is sitting at $177.39, down about 5% year to date, and Wedbush’s Dan Ives just called it a “table pounder” with 30 to 40% upside from current levels. Ives was asked about opportunities in a beaten-down semiconductor and tech sector, including whether the Iran conflict and potential helium shortages could disrupt semiconductor manufacturing. ... Wedbush: Nvidia has 30-40% upside ahead Related tickers mentioned: MSFT, NOW, NVDA.
